title: India rejects reports about denial of airspace to Pakistan to send aid to Sri Lanka
description: India swiftly granted Pakistan permission to use its airspace for humanitarian aid to cyclone-hit Sri Lanka, processing the request within four hours. This humanitarian gesture was made despite Pakistan's prior ban on Indian airlines, with officials dismissing Pakistani media reports of denial as "fake news" and propaganda.
